en.title: Math
en.intro: Learn how to describe parts of a whole with fractions and percentages.

sections.heading: Fractions
text: A fraction like 1/4 means 1 part out of 4 equal parts. The top number is the numerator and the bottom number is the denominator.

sections.heading: Percentages
text: A percentage means 'out of 100'. To change a fraction into a percentage, divide the top by the bottom and multiply by 100.

sections.heading: Finding a percentage of a number
text: To find 10% of 200, divide by 10. To find 50%, divide by 2. To find 25%, divide by 4.

zh.title: 數學
zh.intro: 學習用分數和百分比來表示「整體的一部分」。

sections.heading: 分數
text: 分數 1/4 表示把整體平分成 4 份，取其中 1 份。上面的數字叫分子，下面的數字叫分母。

sections.heading: 百分比
text: 百分比的意思是「每 100 中有幾個」。要把分數變成百分比，先用分子除以分母，再乘以 100。

quiz.q: 在 3/4 中，分母是哪一個數？
